consumers.usage: Its one implementation of .map, APMap and RMF: internal/convert is a thin adapter over mapio.Convert for the CLI and HTTP conversion operations, and its extraction, normalization, prefab and analysis packages import mapio/apmap, mapfile, rmf, convex and pysum directly. Pinned to an exact revision in go.mod.

cmd/mapio wraps mapio.Convert as the auto-pigeon-mapio[.exe] converter the Companion ships and supervises for every build's APMap to .map conversion; it reads capabilities and module identity from the library. Pinned to an exact revision in go.mod.
